title: The Design and Evaluation of an Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm in Autonomous Vehicles with Drivers' Subjective Feelings Considered
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper evaluates an obstacle avoidance algorithm for autonomous vehicles, not aspects of religion or faith.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it focuses on an obstacle avoidance algorithm for autonomous vehicles considering drivers' subjective feelings about safety and comfort.
